tests.title: parses named and positional options with native defaults, names and ranges, and refuses everything else with exact messages
sizes the lookahead as config_input does and refuses attacks too small for the rate and channel count
pins dbl for every input format and plans an unchanged count with an exact state reservation
matches a transcription of the C loop for every option family on 1-3 channels, independent of 1/7/29/50-sample splits, without touching its input
refuses unstable formats, oversized state and frames, emits nothing for empty input and observes cancellation
matches native PCM bytes for the option sweeps on 1-3 channels at 8000/44100/48000 Hz from every raw source format
matches native framecrc across frame splits, chains, WAV input, output selection and frame limits; native output is independent of frame grouping
refuses asc, latency, too small attacks, out-of-range values and enable before output, beside native status

details.compares: raw PCM bytes, -cpuflags 0: 15 option sweeps (plus attack=0.1 above 8000 Hz) x 8000/44100/48000 Hz x 1-3 channels x raw u8/s16/s32/f32/f64 input into f64le, plus s16le raw and s32 WAV for two sweeps

framecrc (pcm_f64le, -bitexact) and raw f64/WAV s16 outputs: raw and WAV input (s16 stereo 44100, f64 mono 48000, f32 3ch 8000), 6 chains (asetnsamples=7, asetnsamples=n=7:p=0, volume before, apad after, two limiters) x 6 input/output -ss/-t/-frames:a profiles, raw/WAV outputs with -ss/-t and -frames:a, and asetnsamples=n=1/7/29/50:p=0 splits
native exit status per refusal (0, 8, 256-EINVAL, 256-ERANGE from os.constants.errno) beside ours: non-zero exit, nothing written, exact message

nativeComparisons.nativeOnlyProbes: 12 native md5 checks: asetnsamples=n=1/7/29/50:p=0 before alimiter equals ungrouped native output

unsupported: FLAC input (refused before decoding: FLAC input to alimiter requires additional Native evidence)
latency=1 (leading-sample trim and padded tail frames)
expressions, SI suffixes and other non-literal numeric values (native accepts)
automatic sample-rate conversion next to alimiter
attacks too small for the rate and channel count (native fails too)

proposedContracts.name: parses named and positional options with native defaults, names and ranges, and refuses everything else with exact messages
proposedContracts.scope: option syntax, native defaults/ranges and exact refusal messages

proposedContracts.name: sizes the lookahead as config_input does and refuses attacks too small for the rate and channel count
proposedContracts.scope: config_input buffer sizes and the attack-too-small constraint

proposedContracts.name: pins dbl for every input format and plans an unchanged count with an exact state reservation
proposedContracts.scope: dbl negotiation, scalar rounding, counts, packet sections and reservations

proposedContracts.name: matches a transcription of the C loop for every option family on 1-3 channels, independent of 1/7/29/50-sample splits, without touching its input
proposedContracts.scope: output against a C-loop transcription on 1-3 channels under 1/7/29/50-sample splits, ownership

proposedContracts.name: refuses unstable formats, oversized state and frames, emits nothing for empty input and observes cancellation
proposedContracts.scope: stream refusals, state and frame allocation limits, empty input and cancellation

proposedContracts.name: matches native PCM bytes for the option sweeps on 1-3 channels at 8000/44100/48000 Hz from every raw source format
proposedContracts.scope: raw PCM bytes vs native across option sweeps, rates, 1-3 channels, sources and outputs

proposedContracts.name: matches native framecrc across frame splits, chains, WAV input, output selection and frame limits; native output is independent of frame grouping
proposedContracts.scope: framecrc/raw/WAV vs native across chains, WAV input, time selection, frame limits and frame splits, plus native frame-grouping independence

proposedContracts.name: refuses asc, latency, too small attacks, out-of-range values and enable before output, beside native status
proposedContracts.scope: explicit refusals before output beside native exit status

notes: asc=0 path has no libm call besides fabs and no contractible a*b+c, so no case is gated; all comparisons ran on linux/x64 only (no macOS run available in the sandbox).
The sandbox Node was 22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24; Node 24.22.3 was installed from nodejs.org (about 10s).

Setup durations: first bootstrap attempt failed immediately (Node 22); bootstrap with Node 24 took 235s (npm 9.5s, submodule 7s, reference build about 218s); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 71s; baseline registry unit tests 4s (26 passed).
Differential file runs in about 25s with --maxWorkers=1; unit file about 4s.
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
